title: NoteVersionCommitted v1.0
description: AUTHORITATIVE. Emitted via the EMR transactional outbox when a clinical note version is committed. Carries identifiers and a content hash only — NEVER note text (claim-check pattern, ADR-0007). Transport: Azure Service Bus message; MessageId = eventId; ContentType = application/json; application properties: eventType, schemaVersion, correlationId (mirrors body).

eventId.description: Unique per outbox row; used as Service Bus MessageId for broker duplicate detection.

occurredAt.description: UTC time the outbox row was written.

sourceSystem.description: Identifies the EMR instance (multi-location networks may run several).

patientId.description: EMR patient identifier (e.g. UHID). PHI identifier.

contentSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 note text. Worker verifies after fetching.

charLength.description: Length in Unicode code points; lets the worker reject over-size notes before fetching.

trigger.description: Set by producer: EMR outbox = realtime; backfill orchestrator = backfill; ops requeue = reprocess.
